questions.question: Why did Naobito Zenin become the 26th head of the Zenin clan?
questions.subject: Naobito Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Eventually, he succeeded his brother, the 25th head of the clan, and became the 26th head due to the quality of his children surpassing Ogi's.

questions.question: Why did Naobito meet with Toji Fushiguro in the past?
questions.subject: Naobito Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: At some point in the past, Naobito met with Toji Fushiguro to discuss Megumi Fushiguro being sold to the Zenin clan, promising a large sum of money if Megumi possessed an inherited technqiue.

questions.question: How was Dagon exorcised during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Naobito Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: When Dagon tried to escape from Toji, Naobito stopped him by kicking him down towards Toji, who pierced him with Playful Cloud before exorcising him with a barrage of stabs.
Jogo created two volcanic openings that fired beams of fire and hit him while he was moving, immolating the Zenin clan head.

questions.question: What did Naobito instruct on his deathbed?
questions.subject: Naobito Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Before passing away, he instructed Furudate to read his will to Ogi, Jinichi, and Naoya Zenin.
